sloka: विप्रियम् न च कर्तव्यम् भरतस्य कदाचन ।स हि राजा प्रभुः चैव देशस्य च कुलस्य च ॥२-२६-३४॥
transliteration: vipriyam na ca kartavyam bharatasya kadācana ।sa hi rājā prabhuḥ caiva deśasya ca kulasya ca ॥2-26-34॥

translations.english: Now Bharata is the king of the country and head of the family. Therefore, you should never do anything disagreeable to him.
